A record that is required to be retained under this Part in relation to plants or plant products must be:

groups.reason: The CP explicitly lists three distinct requirements separated by semicolons, indicating that each is independently required. The Rules provision 11-2(1) introduces a list of mandatory attributes, and paragraphs (a), (c), and (d) each state a separate requirement. Failure of any one attribute would violate the record-keeping requirement.

rationale_summary: The three grounded norms correspond to three distinct, cumulative requirements explicitly enumerated in the CP and in the Rules. They are not alternatives or mere supports; each is independently necessary.
